aboutGame.title: What is Bloodborne?
paragraphs: Bloodborne is a gothic action RPG developed by FromSoftware and directed by Hidetaka Miyazaki. Released for PlayStation 4 on March 24, 2015, it casts you as a Hunter in Yharnam, a city consumed by a beast plague and shaped by the Healing Church's obsession with blood ministration.

Combat rewards aggression: trick weapons transform mid-combo, firearms create parry openings for visceral attacks, and the Rally system lets you recover lost health by striking back. The interconnected city, optional Chalice Dungeons, cryptic NPC questlines, and The Old Hunters expansion support repeated playthroughs and a deep lore trail.

explore.title: Explore the Bloodborne Wiki
explore.description: Eight focused guides cover the opening hours, weapon choices, boss order, build planning, world progression, Chalice Dungeons, The Old Hunters, and the game's endings.

modules.name: Bloodborne Beginner Guide
modules.description: Learn character creation, starting weapons, combat timing, healing, leveling, the Hunter's Dream, and a practical route through Central Yharnam.

highlights.detail: Pick Lone Survivor or Milquetoast for a safer first run, then equip a melee weapon and firearm in the Hunter's Dream.
Choose the Saw Cleaver for balanced damage, the Hunter Axe for crowd control, or the Threaded Cane for reach.
Practice Rally by striking back after a hit, and use the Quickstep's invincibility frames to dodge through attacks.
Fire just before an enemy attack lands to parry, then follow the stagger with a high-damage visceral attack.
Spend Blood Echoes with the Doll before a boss and upgrade your weapon with Blood Stone Shards at the Workshop.
Light every lamp, open shortcut gates, and pull Central Yharnam enemies one at a time before facing Father Gascoigne.

modules.name: Bloodborne Weapons Tier List
modules.description: Rank trick weapons and firearms by damage, versatility, stamina cost, scaling, and fit for Strength, Skill, Bloodtinge, and Arcane builds.

highlights.label: S
highlights.detail: Saw Cleaver, Saw Spear, Ludwig's Holy Blade, Whirligig Saw, Holy Moonlight Sword, Rakuyo, Beasthunter Saif, and Chikage combine top damage with flexible movesets.

highlights.label: A
highlights.detail: Hunter Axe, Kirkhammer, Blades of Mercy, Burial Blade, Church Pick, Simon's Bowblade, Bloodletter, Tonitrus, Kos Parasite, and Logarius' Wheel trade one weakness for strong utility.

highlights.label: B
highlights.detail: Threaded Cane, Stake Driver, Rifle Spear, Reiterpallasch, Beast Cutter, Boom Hammer, Amygdalan Arm, and Beast Claw reward specialist builds.

highlights.label: C
highlights.detail: Fist of Gratia and off-build weapons sit here because their damage or utility falls behind dedicated setups.

modules.name: Bloodborne Boss Guide
modules.description: Prepare for required and optional encounters with progression order, dangerous attacks, weaknesses, and practical tactics for every major fight.

highlights.label: Cleric
highlights.detail: Optional first boss on the Great Bridge; its badge expands the Bath Messenger shop.

highlights.label: Gascoigne
highlights.detail: The first required wall; parry his hunter attacks and avoid panic-rolling.

highlights.label: Amelia
highlights.detail: Required Cathedral Ward boss; use Numbing Mist to stop her healing.

highlights.label: Shadows
highlights.detail: Required Forbidden Woods fight against three enemies; control the group and remove the ranged threat.

highlights.label: Rom
highlights.detail: Required Byrgenwerth boss; clear the adds and watch for arcane projectiles.

highlights.label: Wet Nurse
highlights.detail: Required Nightmare of Mensis boss with clone attacks; keep moving and punish safe openings.

modules.name: Bloodborne Builds and Stats
modules.description: Understand attribute soft caps, weapon scaling, and level 120 spreads for Strength, Skill, Bloodtinge, Arcane, and quality builds.

highlights.label: VIT
highlights.detail: Reach 30 early and 50 late; Vitality is the most forgiving investment for new hunters.

highlights.label: END
highlights.detail: Target 20-30 Endurance for extra swings and dodges before diminishing returns.

highlights.label: STR
highlights.detail: Stop at 25 or 50 Strength for heavy weapons such as the Whirligig Saw and Kirkhammer.

highlights.label: SKL
highlights.detail: Skill raises fast-weapon damage and visceral attacks; 25 or 50 are the key breakpoints.

highlights.label: BLT
highlights.detail: Bloodtinge at 50 supports Chikage, Simon's Bowblade, Bloodletter, and firearm-focused builds.

highlights.label: ARC
highlights.detail: Arcane at 50 powers Hunter Tools and elemental weapons, but comes online later than physical stats.

modules.name: Bloodborne Walkthrough and Area Guide
modules.description: Follow the interconnected route from Central Yharnam to the Nightmare of Mensis, with shortcuts, optional detours, and progression checkpoints.

highlights.label: Central
highlights.detail: Open the lamp shortcuts, consider the optional Cleric Beast, then beat Father Gascoigne.

highlights.label: Cathedral
highlights.detail: Reach Cathedral Ward, speak with the Oedon Chapel Dweller, and defeat Vicar Amelia.

highlights.label: Old Town
highlights.detail: Old Yharnam is optional but grants the Pthumeru Chalice and the free Cathedral Ward gate route.

highlights.label: Forbidden
highlights.detail: Follow the Forbidden Woods route to Shadows of Yharnam and open its shortcut gate early.

highlights.label: Byrgen
highlights.detail: Defeat Rom at Byrgenwerth to trigger the Blood Moon and unlock the late-game shift.

highlights.label: Mensis
highlights.detail: Finish the Nightmare of Mensis, then return to the Hunter's Dream for the final choice.

modules.name: Bloodborne Chalice Dungeon Guide
modules.description: Understand Chalice acquisition, ritual materials, dungeon layers, Depth scaling, root chalices, and the rewards that make the optional dungeons worthwhile.

highlights.label: Pthumeru
highlights.detail: The first Pthumeru Chalice comes from the Blood-Starved Beast and opens the main dungeon line.

highlights.label: Loran
highlights.detail: Ailing Loran adds its own bosses, materials, and root chalices for higher-tier loot.

highlights.label: Isz
highlights.detail: Isz dungeons sit behind Ebrietas and provide another route to Depth 5 rewards.

highlights.label: Depth 5
highlights.detail: Depth sets difficulty; Depth 5 root chalices produce the strongest gems, runes, and Blood Rock chances.

highlights.label: Rites
highlights.detail: Fetid, Rotted, and Cursed rites raise danger and improve the quality of generated rewards.

highlights.label: Rock
highlights.detail: One Blood Rock is available per Pthumeru, Loran, and Isz chalice type, with rare Depth 5 boss drops.

modules.name: Bloodborne DLC The Old Hunters Guide
modules.description: Unlock the expansion, prepare for its difficulty spike, and cover Hunter's Nightmare, Research Hall, the Astral Clocktower, Fishing Hamlet, and their bosses.

highlights.label: Access
highlights.detail: Defeat Vicar Amelia, touch the skull, collect the Eye of a Blood-Drunk Hunter, then let the Amygdala grab you outside Oedon Chapel.

highlights.label: Areas
highlights.detail: The expansion moves through Hunter's Nightmare, Research Hall, the Astral Clocktower, and Fishing Hamlet.

highlights.label: Weapons
highlights.detail: The expansion adds a large set of trick weapons in its opening zone and later areas; they carry back into the base game.

highlights.label: Maria
highlights.detail: Lady Maria is a fast, parryable duel that punishes panic-rolling and greedy healing.

highlights.label: Kos
highlights.detail: Orphan of Kos is the final DLC boss and the hardest encounter in the expansion.

highlights.label: Laurence
highlights.detail: Laurence, the First Vicar is an optional fire-heavy fight hidden in the Grand Cathedral.

modules.name: Bloodborne Endings and Secrets Guide
modules.description: Compare all three endings, the umbilical cord requirements, Gehrman's final choice, the Moon Presence, and the quest details that are easy to miss.

highlights.label: Sunrise
highlights.detail: Accept Gehrman's offer after Mergo's Wet Nurse to reach Yharnam Sunrise without another boss fight.

highlights.label: Wishes
highlights.detail: Refuse Gehrman, defeat him, and take his place in the Hunter's Dream for Honoring Wishes.

highlights.label: Childhood
highlights.detail: Consume three One Third of Umbilical Cord items, refuse Gehrman, and beat the Moon Presence for Childhood's Beginning.

highlights.label: Cords
highlights.detail: Four umbilical cords exist in a playthrough, but only three must be used before the final choice.

highlights.label: Gehrman
highlights.detail: His fast scythe attacks punish healing and panic-rolling; dodge through the arc and parry where possible.

faq.title: Bloodborne FAQ
faq.description: Straight answers about Bloodborne's combat, leveling, DLC access, death penalties, and platforms.

items.question: What is Bloodborne?
items.answer: Bloodborne is a gothic action RPG developed by FromSoftware and released for PlayStation 4 on March 24, 2015. Players become Hunters in the plague-stricken city of Yharnam, using transforming trick weapons and firearms to fight beasts, Great Ones, and other hunters.

items.question: How does Bloodborne's combat work?
items.answer: Bloodborne rewards controlled aggression. Rally lets you recover recently lost health by attacking after a hit, firearm parries create visceral attack openings, and the Quickstep provides invincibility frames when timed correctly.

items.question: How do I level up in Bloodborne?
items.answer: Blood Echoes serve as both currency and experience in Bloodborne. Spend them at the Doll in the Hunter's Dream to raise Vitality, Endurance, Strength, Skill, Bloodtinge, or Arcane.

items.question: How do I access The Old Hunters in Bloodborne?
items.answer: In Bloodborne, defeat Vicar Amelia, touch the skull behind her arena, collect the Eye of a Blood-Drunk Hunter in the Hunter's Dream, then stand in the Cathedral Ward plaza outside Oedon Chapel and let the Amygdala grab you.

items.question: What happens when you die in Bloodborne?
items.answer: When you die in Bloodborne, your carried Blood Echoes drop at the death site or transfer to a nearby enemy. Recover them before dying again; a second death without recovery removes that pool permanently.

items.question: Is there an official PC version of Bloodborne?
items.answer: No official Sony-published PC version of Bloodborne exists. The game remains a PlayStation 4 title and is playable on PlayStation 5 through backward compatibility; community emulation and loader projects require your own copy.
